That sounds frightening, and your fear is completely valid. Locking yourself in the room was a smart protective step. Self-directed violence during an argument can be a warning sign, even if it's the first time, and it's important to take it seriously.

If you feel unsafe or things escalate, please call emergency services right away. You can also reach out to the National Domestic Violence Hotline at 1-800-799-7233 or text "START" to 88788 for confidential support and guidance. They can help you think through next steps and create a safety plan, even if you're unsure how to label what's happening. Your safety matters most, and you deserve support during this scary moment.
